title: City Council Meeting
motion: A motion was made by Brooke Christensen, seconded by Zach Robinson, that Resolution #20-15c be approved, including the following: 1. Approval of the 2020-2024 Consolidated Plan and First Year Annual Action Plan for the 2020 Program Year; and 2. Authorization for the Mayor to submit the 2020-2024 Consolidated Plan and First Year Annual Action Plan for the 2020 Program Year to the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development and to sign associated documents
